title: Warmly Spiced Ethiopian Sea Bass Tartare
description: A nutty and flaky Ethiopian dish featuring sashimi-cut sea bass fillets, perfect for a hangover cure, and served on a wooden board. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe combines warm spices with fresh ingredients.
instructions: Cut the sea bass fillets into small sashimi-cut pieces and place them on a wooden board.
Mix the mitmita spice blend, lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the spice mixture over the sea bass pieces and gently mix until they are well coated.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley, chopped fresh cilantro, and toasted sesame seeds over the top of the sea bass.
Serve the tartare immediately, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
Make sure to handle the sashimi-grade sea bass safely and keep it refrigerated at a temperature of 38 degrees Fahrenheit or below.
Consume the tartare within a few hours of preparation to ensure food safety.
Consider serving the tartare with traditional Ethiopian injera bread or crackers for a more authentic experience.
